question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **equipped**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.

 
 
• **Complex**: Consisting of many different and connected parts. (जटिल)
 
• **Establish**: To start or create an organization, a system, etc. (स्थापित करना)
 
• **Pampered**: Indulge with every attention, comfort, and kindness. (लाड़ प्यार)
 
• **Equipped**: Something that is provided with what is necessary or appropriate. (लैस; साज-सामान सहित)
 
 
 
• So, as per the meaning of the given words "**equipped**" is the most appropriate option.
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: The industry is worldwide recognised for being technologically advanced.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 4.
